summary: The API dry_run query parameter is the local flag --server-dry-run on all 161 commands that have it (plus calls link call-to-contact and imports repair post-imports-id for their body dry-run); no command registers a local --dry-run (import <resource> uses the global one), so the global --dry-run always prints and sends nothing. email send/send-bulk unchanged (exempt). Prose note: .printing-press-patches/reprint-637-server-dry-run.md. Round 4: feedback --send and --deliver webhook:<url> under the global --dry-run print the POST they would make and send nothing.
reason: 4.28.0 prints dry_run as a local --dry-run that shadows the global preview, so a requested local preview sent a real request on 153 pre-existing commands after the full reprint.
validated_outcome: No local --dry-run anywhere in the tree; --server-dry-run bound on every dry_run operation but the two email ones; the global --dry-run on each of them sends zero requests. TestNoLocalDryRunAndServerDryRunIsBound.
upstream_issue: For the press board (not filed): never emit a local flag that shadows a persistent root flag.
